methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 dedicated photo printers spanning professional pigment-inkjet (Canon PIXMA PRO-200, imagePROGRAF PRO-300, Epson SureColor P700/P900), consumer inkjet photo/AIO (Epson EcoTank Photo ET-8550, PictureMate PM-400, Canon PIXMA TS8320, PIXMA G620, HP ENVY Inspire 7955e), and portable dye-sublimation/instant-film printers (Canon SELPHY CP1500, Kodak Dock Plus, Fujifilm Instax Link Wide). Sources are manufacturer product/spec pages and official newsroom/press releases (Canon USA, Epson US/news.epson.com, HP.com regional spec page, Fujifilm US, PRNewswire-hosted Epson release, Kodak's licensed retail site), cross-checked against Consumer Reports where relevant. priceUsd is the launch/official US price in USD unless the priceNote states it is a current list/street price; street-vs-launch deltas are flagged per product. max_print_size_in and max_resolution_dpi carry units inline as strings; ink_colors is a unitless channel count (null where not published). borderless, roll_paper_support and duplex are booleans reflecting standard (not optional-accessory-only) capability unless noted. ADVERSARIAL RE-VERIFICATION (accessedAt 2026-08-16): independently re-fetched every source. All 12 products exist and were confirmed real. All 12 prices and headline specs corroborated against manufacturer pages/press releases (Canon shop/support/newsroom pages loaded live; Epson P700/P900 $799/$1,295 and Apr 21 2020 confirmed via news.epson.com; SELPHY CP1500 $139.99/Sep 14 2022 via Canon newsroom; Kodak Dock Plus $177.99 list / $95.49 sale confirmed on kodakphotoprinter.com; Instax Link Wide 3-color-OLED/318dpi confirmed on Fujifilm; HP 7955e specs on hp.com regional page + ~$229.99 price on Consumer Reports). Only change made: HP ENVY Inspire 7955e releaseDate nulled — no live primary source states a launch year. No products removed. Any field not verifiable on a live source is null rather than estimated.
